NEXIUM Storage

S3-compatible cloud object storage platform. Built for developers who want a simple, fast-to-integrate, friction-free solution.

  • S3-compatible object storage

    Integrate with any tool on the market

  • Buckets, projects, API keys

    Clear organization, secure access per project

  • Presigned URLs & public access

    Serve your files directly from the CDN

  • Webhooks

    Receive real-time events in your backend

# Upload a file
curl -X POST \
-H "Authorization: Bearer nx_live_..." \
-F "file=@photo.jpg" \
https://api.nexiumai.io/v1/ext/buckets/<id>/files
